parts.zh: 一只受惊的猫在一辆汽车的引擎盖下完成了五英里的往返行程
"我们甚至不确定它是否还活着,所以我用一根棍子轻轻推了推它,确认它还在呼吸,发现是一只受惊的小猫。它往引擎深处又退了退,被卡住了。我试图够到它,但它在太深的地方,我没办法把它弄出来
经过英国慈善机构Cats Protection的救援
这家巧克力公司此前曾诉诸法庭以保护其畅销巧克力产品
W: 这有点悲观,不过我在某种程度上能理解
M: 是啊。那个部分太简短了
W: 实际上是四分之一的人

items.stem: Where was the black cat found?

choices.text: Outside the office of a charity foundation.
choices.zh: 在一家慈善基金会的办公室外面。

choices.text: Inside the car of David King's neighbour.
choices.zh: 在David King邻居的车内。

choices.text: Under the engine cover of a man's car.
choices.zh: 在一名男子汽车的引擎盖下面。

choices.text: At the gate of a grade school in Kent.
choices.zh: 在Kent一所小学的大门口。

items.stem: What do we learn about the cat at the end of the news report?

choices.text: It got reunited with its owner.
choices.zh: 它与主人团聚了。

choices.text: It was injured during the rescue.
choices.zh: 它在救援过程中受伤了。

choices.text: It became a pet of Mr King's grandson.
choices.zh: 它成为了King先生孙子的宠物。

choices.text: It was placed in the care of a UK charity.
choices.zh: 它被交由一家英国慈善机构照料。

items.stem: What will Fayetteville witness in less than a month?

choices.text: The 100th anniversary celebration of Methodist University.
choices.zh: Methodist University 的百年校庆庆典。

choices.text: The first important political event in the next five years.
choices.zh: 未来五年中的第一个重要政治活动。

choices.text: The opening of the Special Olympics Spring Games.
choices.zh: 特殊奥林匹克春季运动会的开幕式。

choices.text: The reunion of this year's Olympic gold medalists.
choices.zh: 今年奥运会金牌得主的重聚。

items.stem: What did Benjamin Kowalczyk say is rewarding to see?

choices.text: Volunteers visit the Games' website to sign up.
choices.zh: 志愿者访问运动会网站报名参加。

choices.text: Athletes with special needs triumph in the Games.
choices.zh: 有特殊需要的运动员在运动会上取得胜利。

choices.text: Organizers devote their time and energy to the Games.
choices.zh: 组织者为运动会投入他们的时间和精力。

choices.text: Children play in a fun tent and enjoy themselves fully.
choices.zh: 孩子们在趣味帐篷里玩耍并尽情享受。

items.stem: What has the German supermarket been ordered to do?

choices.text: Destroy its imitation chocolate rabbits.
choices.zh: 销毁其仿制的巧克力兔子。

choices.text: Change the wrapping of its commodities.
choices.zh: 更改其商品的包装。

choices.text: Compensate for the Swiss manufacturer's loss.
choices.zh: 赔偿瑞士制造商的损失。

choices.text: Defend itself in the country's commercial court.
choices.zh: 在该国商事法院为自己辩护。

items.stem: What did Switzerland's highest court suggest about the chocolate in question?

choices.text: It could be rewrapped and sold by the budget supermarket.
choices.zh: 它可以被重新包装并由廉价超市出售。

choices.text: It could be reshaped into animals other than rabbits.
choices.zh: 它可以被重新塑造成兔子以外的动物。

choices.text: It could be resold cheaper to avoid waste.
choices.zh: 它可以以更低价格转售以避免浪费。

choices.text: It could be reused in other products.
choices.zh: 它可以在其他产品中重新使用。

items.stem: Why did Switzerland's highest court overturn the commercial court's ruling?

choices.text: To be fair to the German supermarkets.
choices.zh: 为了对德国超市公平。

choices.text: To protect chocolate retailers' interests.
choices.zh: 为了保护巧克力零售商的利益。

choices.text: To boost the growth of the chocolate industry.
choices.zh: 为了促进巧克力行业的增长。

choices.text: To prevent consumers' possible confusion.
choices.zh: 为了防止消费者可能产生的混淆。

items.stem: What does the man request the woman to do?

choices.text: Return the handbook to him.
choices.zh: 把手册还给他。

choices.text: Make a vegetable dish.
choices.zh: 做一道蔬菜菜肴。

choices.text: Pass a book to him.
choices.zh: 把一本书递给他。

choices.text: Meet his sister's boyfriend.
choices.zh: 见见他姐姐的男朋友。

items.stem: What does the woman say about eating vegetables only?

choices.text: It doesn't seem to be a balanced diet.
choices.zh: 这似乎不是均衡的饮食。

choices.text: It would reduce one's protein intake.
choices.zh: 这会减少一个人的蛋白质摄入。

choices.text: It would do harm to one's muscles.
choices.zh: 这会对一个人的肌肉造成伤害。

choices.text: It doesn't sound practical for her.
choices.zh: 这对她来说听起来不实际。

items.stem: Why does the boyfriend of the man's sister choose to be a vegetarian?

choices.text: To improve his health.
choices.zh: 为了改善他的健康。

choices.text: To protect animal rights.
choices.zh: 为了保护动物权利。

choices.text: To follow a trendy lifestyle.
choices.zh: 为了追随时尚的生活方式。

choices.text: To stick to his religious belief.
choices.zh: 为了坚持他的宗教信仰。

items.stem: On what point does the man agree with the woman at the end of the conversation?

choices.text: The torture and distress dolphins suffer in parks.
choices.zh: 海豚在公园里遭受的折磨和痛苦。

choices.text: The necessity of having zoos and eating meat.
choices.zh: 拥有动物园和吃肉的必要性。

choices.text: The gloomy environments animals are kept in.
choices.zh: 动物被饲养的阴暗环境。

choices.text: The urgency of joining an animal rights group.
choices.zh: 加入动物权利组织的紧迫性。

items.stem: What part of the TV program does the man say was interesting?

choices.text: The part about getting over jetlag.
choices.zh: 关于克服时差反应的部分。

choices.text: The part about air travel in the past.
choices.zh: 关于过去航空旅行的部分。

choices.text: The part about not eating on board the plane.
choices.zh: 关于不在飞机上进食的部分。

choices.text: The part about avoiding sleeping on the plane.
choices.zh: 关于避免在飞机上睡觉的部分。

items.stem: What does the man say he will do next time he flies a long distance?

choices.text: Take a nap to adjust to a new time zone.
choices.zh: 小睡一会儿以适应新时区。

choices.text: Have meals as usual to stay away from hunger.
choices.zh: 像平常一样进餐以避免饥饿。

choices.text: Concentrate on reading articles recommended by experts.
choices.zh: 专注阅读专家推荐的文章。

choices.text: Try following the advice given by the expert on the show.
choices.zh: 尝试遵循节目中专家给出的建议。

items.stem: Why does the woman think she is lucky?

choices.text: She does not have any problem flying.
choices.zh: 她乘飞机没有任何问题。

choices.text: She can spend a lot of time vacationing.
choices.zh: 她可以花大量时间度假。

choices.text: She does not have to worry about jetlag.
choices.zh: 她不必担心时差反应。

choices.text: She has been well treated when traveling.
choices.zh: 她在旅行时得到了很好的待遇。

items.stem: Why does the woman think the problem of being afraid to fly deserves attention?

choices.text: It has caused heavy losses to many airlines.
choices.zh: 它给许多航空公司造成了重大损失。

choices.text: It impacts female travelers more seriously.
choices.zh: 它对女性旅客的影响更严重。

choices.text: It has long been ignored by many experts.
choices.zh: 它长期以来被许多专家忽视。

choices.text: It affects twenty-five percent of people.
choices.zh: 它影响百分之二十五的人。

items.stem: What does the speaker think is the best way to get started in user experience design?

choices.text: Learning from skilled designers.
choices.zh: 向熟练的设计师学习。

choices.text: Obtaining real-world experience.
choices.zh: 获得真实世界的经验。

choices.text: Joining a 6-month training camp.
choices.zh: 参加为期6个月的培训营。

choices.text: Anticipating actual challenges.
choices.zh: 预见实际挑战。

items.stem: What does the speaker say being effective requires?

choices.text: Core skills.
choices.zh: 核心技能。

choices.text: Higher education.
choices.zh: 高等教育。

choices.text: Adaptability.
choices.zh: 适应能力。

choices.text: Capability.
choices.zh: 能力。

items.stem: What can people do as long as they know their end goal and strive for it?

choices.text: Start anywhere.
choices.zh: 从任何地方开始。

choices.text: Face challenges.
choices.zh: 面对挑战。

choices.text: Pursue roles in teams.
choices.zh: 在团队中追求角色。

choices.text: Follow their own path.
choices.zh: 遵循自己的道路。

items.stem: Why did the school principal ask what needed to change?

choices.text: To respond actively to students' requests.
choices.zh: 积极回应学生的要求。

choices.text: To engage students more in their learning.
choices.zh: 让学生更多地参与到学习中。

choices.text: To enable teachers to interact more with their students.
choices.zh: 使教师能够更多地与学生互动。

choices.text: To allow students more freedom in their academic work.
choices.zh: 让学生在学业上拥有更多自由。

items.stem: What has flexible seating meant at the speaker's school?

choices.text: Using new furniture to create a comfortable environment.
choices.zh: 使用新家具营造舒适的环境。

choices.text: Shifting from traditional teaching to task-based learning.
choices.zh: 从传统教学转向基于任务的学习。

choices.text: Adopting a variety of different seating options.
choices.zh: 采用多种不同的座位选择。

choices.text: Rearranging most traditional chairs and desks.
choices.zh: 重新摆放大部分传统的椅子和课桌。

items.stem: What has flexible seating brought about at the speaker's school?

choices.text: A win for all people involved.
choices.zh: 对所有相关人员都有益。

choices.text: A strengthened effect of its discipline.
choices.zh: 加强了纪律效果。

choices.text: A harmonious relationship among its students.
choices.zh: 学生之间关系和谐。

choices.text: A change to teachers' opinion of their students.
choices.zh: 改变了教师对学生的看法。

items.stem: Why were dozens of British students sent home on Tuesday?

choices.text: They weren't informed of the school's updated rules.
choices.zh: 他们没有被告知学校更新的规定。

choices.text: They arrived late for their first day of school.
choices.zh: 他们在开学第一天迟到了。

choices.text: They answered their headteacher's email in an impolite way.
choices.zh: 他们以不礼貌的方式回复了校长的电子邮件。

choices.text: They didn't wear the shoes required by the school's new policy.
choices.zh: 他们没有穿学校新政策要求的鞋子。

items.stem: What can the price of school uniforms spark among families in financial difficulty?

choices.text: Riots.
choices.zh: 骚乱。

choices.text: Anger.
choices.zh: 愤怒。

choices.text: Disputes.
choices.zh: 争议。

choices.text: Panic.
choices.zh: 恐慌。

items.stem: What did the headteacher think of the school's new uniform rules?

choices.text: They strengthened the school's discipline and order.
choices.zh: 它们加强了学校的纪律和秩序。

choices.text: They improved student behavior and performance.
choices.zh: 它们改善了学生的行为和表现。

choices.text: They enhanced the positive image of the school.
choices.zh: 它们提升了学校的正面形象。

choices.text: They rendered the school unique in the district.
choices.zh: 它们使学校在该地区独树一帜。

items.stem: What did Lucinda May have to do to buy her child the correct pair of shoes?

choices.text: Turn to her parents for help.
choices.zh: 向她的父母求助。

choices.text: Tighten her monthly budget.
choices.zh: 压缩她的月度预算。

choices.text: Borrow £65 from her friend.
choices.zh: 向她的朋友借65英镑。

choices.text: Postpone paying her other bills.
choices.zh: 推迟支付她的其他账单。
